summary: 2026/27 component evidence for Arsenal, Fulham and Manchester City. Fixed SWOS palette is approximate. No original game files changed.

entries.note: The standard Arsenal 26/27 home pairing is white shorts and red socks (current-season independent kit coverage, official adidas component pages). Red alternate shorts exist. SWOS omits the shirt's detailed pattern and burgundy trim.
Fulham's official 26/27 launch specifies black home shorts and white socks with black/red accent trim. SWOS cannot reproduce subtle shirt patterns or small trims.

PUMA's 26/27 home range contains Icy Blue-Team Light Blue shorts and socks. SWOS Light Blue approximates icy/sky blue; gradient cannot be modelled. Multiple accessory colour options exist; this is the matching icy-blue pairing.
